verdict.rationale: The platform's own client lets users submit autonomous agent tasks asynchronously and collect results later, and Kosmos runs full research workflows end to end without supervision. That covers autonomous background execution of one-off jobs. There is no evidence of recurring schedules, triggers or persistent automation definitions, and a one-off async job is not the same as a set-up automation. missing for 10: scheduled/recurring automations, event triggers, completion notifications/webhooks, automation management UI, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Sometimes you may want to submit many jobs, while querying results at a later time. The platform API supports this
Asynchronous tasks: get_task(task_id) or aget_task(task_id) and create_task(TaskRequest) or acreate_task(TaskRequest)
Given a research objective and one or more datasets, Kosmos autonomously reads literature, writes and executes analysis code, generates hypotheses, and produces a comprehensive cited report.
